source_attribution: The original and differential qualification started on parent a4a7ecb with uncommitted implementation bytes. Their adapter, indexer and checker hashes match implementation commit1445e29 exactly. The paired benchmark records committed1445e29. c424f8d changes reporting and adds a separate instrumented memory diagnostic; engine and Rust source remain byte-identical.
memory_limit: Raw benchmark wait4 highwaters include inherited launcher memory and do not establish memory savings. Separately pinned phase-memory.json reports confirmed post-exec highwaters and sampled RSS with explicit limits.
trust_boundary: HMAC authority, reuse predicate, kernel rules, full changed-byte parsing and MathGraph consumer remain unchanged. Native identity implementation joins the trusted applicability extractor when opted in; its captured binary hash is pinned in receipt provenance. Differential mismatch, malformed protocol, timeout or unexplained crash issues no evidence.
residual: Changed-input identity still scans and fingerprints the entire typed DAG; full-export generation and byte hashing remain O(total input). Authenticated producer deltas are not implemented or trusted. Economic superiority to direct Rust full checking is rejected for this measured local workload/version; asymptotic change-proportional total verification remains UNKNOWN.
